meta.name: enigmatamod
meta.author: Blam
meta.description:
A campaign mod with a planet themed around magic.

Completion rate: ~50%

Content is designed with intention . Tech tree is non-linear, and levels actually play differently from each other.

Lore is for chumps, this is raw gameplay injected right into your veins!

[red[]]Difficulty:[[]] modest, no handholding
[yellow[]]Length:[[]] short if you're good
[green[]]Quality:[[]] astonishing really
[cyan[]]Translation:[[]] none
[cyan[]]Release date:[[]] in the future
